is a simple, beginner-friendly pod system with draw-activated firing  -  no buttons or screen needed. The 800mAh battery provides all-day vaping with adjustable airflow for MTL to RDL styles.

description_html:
The VOOPOO Argus Pod SE Pod Kit is a simple, beginner-friendly pod system with draw-activated firing - no buttons or screen needed. The 800mAh battery provides all-day vaping with adjustable airflow for MTL to RDL styles.

  • Product Type: Open Pod System (Refillable)
  • Battery: 800mAh
  • Wattage: Up to 18W (Auto-Adjusts)
  • Charging: USB Type-C
  • E-Liquid Capacity: 2mL
  • Coil Type: Integrated (Argus Pod Cartridge)
  • Coil Resistance: 0.7Ω and 1.2Ω (both included)
  • Activation: Draw-Activated (No Buttons)
  • Display: 3 LED Battery Indicator
  • Airflow: Adjustable (Front Slider)
  • Material: Zinc Alloy
  • Pod Compatibility: All VOOPOO Argus Pod Family cartridges (Argus Pod 0.7Ω/1.2Ω, Argus Top Fill, Argus Top Fill V2)
  • Brand: VOOPOO

⚠ Not compatible with PnP X pods or coils (DRAG X3, S3, S2). This device uses Argus Pod cartridges only.

E-liquid sold separately. Fill with your choice of salt nic or freebase e-liquid.

Available options: Red, Shiny Orange, Shiny Blue.
